name: How long does typical jobsite cleanup and project closeout take for a residential remodel?

mainEntity.name: How long does typical jobsite cleanup and project closeout take for a residential remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of jobsite cleanup and project closeout varies based on the project's size and complexity. For a standard residential remodel, cleanup might take a few days, while the full closeout process, including final inspections and documentation, can extend for a week or two. Projects in cities like Albany or El Cerrito with specific permitting requirements might have slightly longer closeout phases due to local inspection schedules.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cleanup can take days, while full closeout might take 1-2 weeks, depending on project size and local requirements.
